en.title: HuggingFace Model: ISTA-DASLab/Qwen3.8-27B-GSQ-RCO-GGUF
en.hook: A GGUF-quantized Qwen 27B vision-language model optimized via GSQ-RCO for high-efficiency local inference.
key_takeaways: Provides GGUF quantized weights for the 27B Qwen vision-language architecture
Utilizes GSQ-RCO quantization techniques to achieve optimal memory-to-performance ratio
Enables local image-text processing through llama.cpp and compatible edge inference runtimes
